zh: 把小票留着，万一要退货。
en: Keep the {receipt} in case you need to return it.

zh: 这个用不了，我想退款。
en: It doesn't work, so I'd like a {refund}, please.

zh: 学生可以享受百分之十的折扣。
en: Students get a ten percent {discount}.

zh: 人太多了，我在收银台等了很久。
en: It was so busy that I waited ages at the {checkout|till|counter}.

zh: 无麸质食品在健康食品区。
en: Gluten-free food is in the health food {section|aisle|area}.

zh: 推一辆购物车吧，我们要买很多东西。
en: Grab a {trolley|cart}, we need a lot of things.

zh: 这台笔记本电脑有两年保修。
en: The laptop comes with a two-year {warranty|guarantee}.

zh: 我生日收到了几张礼品券。
en: I got some gift {vouchers|cards} for my birthday.

zh: 她为婚礼配了一整套新行头——裙子、鞋子和包。
en: She put together a whole new {outfit|look} for the wedding: dress, shoes and bag.

zh: 那双鞋才五十块？真是捡到便宜了。
en: Only fifty dollars for those shoes? That's a real {bargain|steal|deal}.

zh: 夏季大减价从节礼日开始。
en: The summer {sale} starts on Boxing Day.

zh: 您需要袋子吗？
en: Do you need any {bags}?

zh: 这件有大一号的吗？
en: Do you have this in a bigger {size}?

zh: 她试了五条裙子，但一条都没买。
en: She tried on five {dresses} but didn't buy any of them.

zh: 我一般买便宜一点的牌子。
en: I usually buy the cheaper {brands}.

zh: 我每周去买一次日常食品杂货。
en: I buy my {groceries} once a week.

zh: 您付现金还是刷卡？
en: Cash or {EFTPOS|card}?

zh: 周六店里挤满了顾客。
en: The shop was full of {customers|shoppers|people} on Saturday.

zh: 买的商品不到十件可以走这个通道。
en: You can use this lane if you have fewer than ten {items|things}.

zh: 收银员忘了给我袋子。
en: The {cashier} forgot to give me a bag.

zh: 抱歉，那个颜色我们没货了。
en: Sorry, we don't have that colour in {stock}.

zh: 消费满五十元免运费吗？
en: Is {delivery|shipping|postage} free if I spend over fifty dollars?

zh: 今天早上有两个你的包裹到了。
en: Two {parcels|packages|boxes} arrived for you this morning.

zh: 我的订单还没到。
en: My {order} still hasn't arrived.

zh: 看一下标签，看能不能机洗。
en: Check the {label|tag} to see if you can put it in the washing machine.

zh: 我需要买几件上班穿的新衣服。
en: I need some new {clothes} for work.

zh: 这件的袖子对我来说太长了。
en: The {sleeves|arms} are too long for me.

zh: 这条裤子太紧了。
en: These {trousers|pants} are too tight.

zh: 我们周六去商场逛逛吧。
en: Let's go to the {mall} on Saturday and look around.

zh: 我们每周去超市大采购一次。
en: We do one big shop at the {supermarket} every week.

zh: 街角的小卖部开到晚上十点。
en: The {dairy|shop|store} on the corner is open until ten at night.

zh: 你们周日的营业时间是几点到几点？
en: What are your opening {hours|times} on Sunday?

zh: 我在 Trade Me 的网上拍卖中买到了这辆自行车。
en: I got this bike in an online {auction} on Trade Me.

zh: 如果牛仔裤太长，这家店可以免费修改。
en: The shop does free {alterations} if your jeans are too long.

zh: 我把那件大衣办了预留分期（先留货，付清再取），每周付一点。
en: I put the coat on {layby|lay-by} and I'm paying it off each week.

zh: 我买了一双新跑鞋。
en: I bought a new {pair} of running shoes.

zh: 我买的吸尘器有故障，开不了机。
en: There's a {fault|problem} with the vacuum cleaner I bought. It won't turn on.

zh: 屏幕上有划痕，所以我想换一个。
en: There are {scratches|marks} on the screen, so I'd like to exchange it.

zh: 我要投诉你们的服务。
en: I'd like to make a {complaint} about the service.

zh: 他们这周有一些很划算的优惠。
en: They have some great {offers|deals|specials|bargains|discounts} this week.

zh: 这些水果的塑料包装太多了。
en: There's far too much plastic {packaging|wrapping} on this fruit.

zh: 把苹果放在秤上称一下。
en: Put the apples on the {scales} to weigh them.

zh: 我要一打鸡蛋。
en: I'll take a {dozen} eggs, please.

zh: 我只买几样东西，拿个篮子就行。
en: I only need a few things, so I'll just take a {basket}.

zh: 坐自动扶梯上去就是电影院。
en: Take the {escalator} up to the cinema.

zh: 男装在三楼。
en: Menswear is on the third {floor|level}.

zh: 质量不错，但是太贵了。
en: The {quality} is good, but it costs too much.

zh: 这件衬衫是什么料子做的？
en: What {material|fabric} is this shirt made of?

zh: 机器扫不了这个条形码。
en: The machine couldn't scan the {barcode|code}.

zh: 我还得给家人买圣诞礼物。
en: I still need to buy Christmas {gifts|presents} for my family.
